strengths: Correctly recognizes the proximal tubule lineage from the dominant marker block (SLC13A1, PDZK1IP1, ALDOB, GLYAT, BHMT, NAT8).
Concordant with the downstream S3 segment refinement present in the same marker set.
weaknesses: The raw top label could not be mapped to a CLID (status_mismatch_ambiguous_unmapped).
No ontology-resolved component/subtype is provided despite the S3-like marker signal.

strengths: Deterministically mapped to CL:0000066 and supported by epithelial markers PAX8 and KRT8.
Second candidate, epithelial cell of proximal tubule (CL:0002306), is an ontology-valid descendant with direct marker support.
weaknesses: The top1 label is too generic and discards the proximal tubule-specific information in the DEGs.
Low top1 candidate score (0.15) while proximal tubule subtype candidates score higher (0.45).

clusterProfiler.predicted_cell_type: epithelial cell of proximal tubule segment 3
strengths: Selects the most specific ontology-valid node supported by the original DEGs.
Uses S3-associated markers observed in the cluster (SLC13A1, SLC16A12, BHMT, BHMT2, HOGA1) and amino acid/sulfur metabolic enrichment.
Correctly excludes podocyte and lymphatic endothelial branches using absence of NPHS1/NPHS2 and LYVE1/PECAM1 signals.
weaknesses: S3-precision depends on interpretation of segment-associated markers rather than a dedicated CLID majority.
Some supporting genes (PAX8, KRT8, CA2, KCNJ16) are not S3-exclusive.

supporting: Cluster DEGs include PAX8 and KRT8, establishing an epithelial identity.
Proximal tubule identity is supported by SLC13A1, PDZK1IP1, TINAG, ALDOB, PAH, GLYAT, NAT8, and S100A1.
S3 segment refinement is supported by observed SLC13A1, SLC16A12, BHMT, BHMT2, HOGA1 and choline/amino-acid metabolic programs (PMID 35364009).
enrichment_or_literature: Amino acid metabolic process, sulfur compound metabolic process, and KEGG hsa00260/hsa00670 are consistent with high metabolic activity of proximal tubule S3.
PMID 35364009 supports the proximal tubule segment marker interpretation.
